source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As your **[Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase)** begins, you may choose one combat doctrine from the three below. Until your next Command phase starts, it applies to every friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit that has this ability. **Assault Doctrine**: an **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** leaves the unit still able to declare a charge later that turn. **Devastator Doctrine**: **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** applies to the unit's ranged attacks. **Tactical Doctrine**: a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** leaves the unit still able to shoot and to declare a charge later that turn. Unless a rule says otherwise, your army may choose each combat doctrine only once per battle, and a unit can have just one combat doctrine active; if some rule activates a new one for that unit, the earlier one stops applying to it.
